generator_settings.sensitivity_selection: First declared opaqueID of each privately assigned family; fixed before response outcomes. Calibration+80mm n6, plus80mm halfstep at BOTH n4/n6.
generator_settings.gpu_fallback: CPU per-lane if launch-time headroom unavailable; record census, same physics, no unrelatedjobchanges
generator_settings.invalid_reference_policy: All original worlds/jobs/failed prefixes retained. No replacement, height reduction, survivor-only primary mean, or claim unexamined references are qualified.
generator_settings.scope: Fresh finite-resolution synthetic load-magnitude extrapolation only, knowngeometry/mass and oracle3Dtracks. Not continuumtruth, rawvideo inference, or interaction-type generalization.

required_approval: Final protocol+methodfreeze+independent prefitaudit exact SHA bindings before run

metrics.initial_appearance: Same frozen initial Gaussian checkpoint and same retained-opacity mask for both methods; native K16 versus material/F transport. Motion and transport jointly affect images. Common procedural renderer separately isolates geometry.
metrics.time_sampling: 31 simultaneous frames at100Hz includingt0; no time/rigid alignment in world or image scores.
metrics.views: Three observed-camera poses and two held camera poses, fixed across methods. Appearance trained only on initialstate of development geometry; no future appearance optimization.
metrics.aggregation: Report all four worlds and eight forecasts. Equal-weight world summary if all valid complete; otherwise primary completion coverage plus paired per-world results and clearly conditional complete-case summaries. No replacement or survivor-only primary advantage claim. Four worlds too few for strong population inference.
metrics.success_interpretation: Seek lower world and shape forecast errors with comparable native-appearance quality. Report signed paired differences, no assumed win. A2dB foregroundPSNR/.02SSIM difference is a descriptive practical band, not a statistical equivalence claim.
metrics.reference_scope: Finite-resolution analytic MR/Yeoh teachers; n4/n6 and timestep sensitivity on declared subset. Failed or unqualified references retained and explicitly separated from qualified evidence. Not real-world accuracy proof.
metrics.mass_discretization_scope: Both methods receive known0.27kg and uniform canonical geometry. Native125equal-mass q5points have1.5times continuum rest rotational inertia; Q2 uses consistent uniform-density mass. Native729capacity control has1.25times continuum inertia. This is a configuration-level comparison, not causal isolation of constitutive law; elastic modes/contact response can reflect mass discretization. No rigidrotation challenge claimed.
